concerns.text: Task T005 implements selection‑bias handling (FR‑016) but specifies a fallback that sets all weights to 1.0 and logs `[SELECTION_BIAS_MISSING]` when the injection/selection‑efficiency download fails. This fallback effectively skips bias correction, which weakens the mandatory requirement that the system *must* correct for selection bias. The spec does not provide an allowed degradation path, so the task violates FR‑016.
